-- Test the urgency score calculation
SELECT 
    c.clin_recip_registry AS patient_id,
    c.med_urgency AS life_support_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
        WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
        WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 2' OR c.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
        WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 3' OR c.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
        ELSE 1
    END AS status_value,
    CAST(SUBSTRING(c.wait_time FROM '\d+') AS INTEGER) / 365.0 AS wait_ratio,
    (CASE 
        WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
        WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
        WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 2' OR c.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
        WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 3' OR c.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
        ELSE 1
    END) * 0.7 + (CAST(SUBSTRING(c.wait_time FROM '\d+') AS INTEGER) / 365.0) * 0.3 AS urgency_score
FROM clinical c
WHERE c.med_urgency IN ('Status 1A', 'Status 1B')
LIMIT 5;

-- Build the full query with window function for average per organ
WITH patient_scores AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.clin_recip_registry AS patient_id,
        c.med_urgency AS life_support_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 2' OR c.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 3' OR c.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS status_value,
        CAST(SUBSTRING(c.wait_time FROM '\d+') AS INTEGER) / 365.0 AS wait_ratio,
        tm.org_spec
    FROM clinical c
    JOIN transplant_matching tm ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
),
all_scores AS (
    SELECT *,
        status_value * 0.7 + wait_ratio * 0.3 AS urgency_score
    FROM patient_scores
)
SELECT 
    patient_id,
    life_support_type,
    ROUND(CAST(urgency_score AS numeric), 2) AS urgency_score,
    org_spec,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(urgency_score) OVER (PARTITION BY org_spec) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_organ_score
FROM all_scores
WHERE life_support_type IN ('Status 1A', 'Status 1B')
ORDER BY org_spec, urgency_score DESC;
